name: calculator-apk
description: Modern, responsive scientific & standard calculator mobile app ready for Capacitor Android bundling

scripts.cap:add:android: npm run build && npx cap add android
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
scripts.cap:run:android: npm run build && npx cap run android
scripts.serve: node -e "const http=require('http'),fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');const port=3000;const mime={'html':'text/html','css':'text/css','js':'text/javascript','json':'application/json','svg':'image/svg+xml'};http.createServer((req,res)=>{let f=req.url==='/'?'/index.html':req.url;let p=path.join(__dirname,'www',f);fs.readFile(p,(e,d)=>{if(e){res.writeHead(404);res.end('Not Found');}else{let ext=path.extname(p).slice(1);res.writeHead(200,{'Content-Type':mime[ext]||'text/plain'});res.end(d);}});}).listen(port,()=>console.log('App running at http://localhost:'+port));"
